baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive أُلْقُوا, the dative لَهَا, and the independent clause وَهِىَ تَفُورُ shift agency from the entrants to the destination.
baseline_models.mechanism: Casting reduces the entrants to transferred objects, while the destination acts as an audible, surging receiver: they cross its boundary, but it supplies the breathlike sound and boiling motion that dominate the encounter.

activation_trace.role: Literal casting or throwing makes the entrants passive matter delivered into the receiver.
Auditory perception makes the receiver's activity unavoidable sensory evidence.
A high, forceful drawing of breath gives the destination an intake-like voice.
Boiling, surging, and ejection supply the receiver's visible material response.

changed_reading.before: They are thrown into the fire and hear its roar while it boils.
changed_reading.after: They enter as passive cargo into an active receiver whose breathlike voice and boiling motion seize control of the encounter.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: إِذَا couples the moment of أُلْقُوا directly to شَهِيقًا and تَفُورُ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The casting is not merely followed by a standing condition. Encounter imagery in ل ق ي and the first, unsettled impulse in ف و ر make arrival a trigger: contact elicits an immediate voiced surge before any settling can occur.

activation_trace.role: The meeting of opposed sides recasts casting as the instant of contact with the destination.
An agitated body's internal voice makes the sound a reaction to arrival rather than neutral ambience.
The first impulse before stillness supplies the event's immediate onset.

changed_reading.before: The fire is already roaring and boiling when they arrive.
changed_reading.after: Their contact with it triggers a first voiced surge, so the line depicts reception as an event rather than a static background.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: شَهِيقًا names an inward breath while تَفُورُ names boiling that rises or casts material outward.
baseline_models.mechanism: The adjacent but directionally opposed branch images support a pressure cycle: inward draw is heard while outward surge is seen. The destination behaves less like a flat flame and more like a pulsing, pressurized body.

activation_trace.role: Drawing breath supplies the inward phase and its elevated sound.
Boiling and throwing up material supply the outward pressure phase.

changed_reading.before: شَهِيق and boiling are two parallel descriptions of loud fire.
changed_reading.after: They can be read as paired phases of a pressurized body, audibly drawing inward while materially surging outward.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sovereign control, deliberate ordering, a punishment already made ready, and a named destination turn the active receiver into a prepared reception system. Its surge is not autonomous disorder; it performs a condition established before the entrants arrive.

activation_trace.role: Casting supplies delivery into the already established destination.
The destination's boiling supplies the active reception behavior to be explained.
Dominion and sovereignty place the receiving process inside an encompassing authority.
Ordering an affair by measure and deliberation supplies prior arrangement rather than accident.
Something present and prepared makes the punishment ready before the casting occurs.
Arrival at an outcome supplies the terminal destination immediately preceding the focus.

structural_cues: The opening assigns dominion and capability, 67:5 says punishment is prepared, and 67:6 names the destination directly before 67:7.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sovereignty, measured ordering, prior preparation, and destination; I connect them to the receiver's active behavior as staged reception. A live alternative is that these cues frame authority without specifying the mechanics of its sound or boiling.

changed_reading.before: The entrants meet a chaotically raging inferno.
changed_reading.after: They are delivered into a deliberately prepared destination whose violent reception remains an enacted part of the surrounding order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first denies any visible fissure in the heavens and exhausts repeated sight, then describes the destination as nearly tearing apart from fury that can become audible. Between them, the focus sound functions as acoustic evidence of pressure at a boundary that sight could not find in the ordered heavens.

activation_trace.role: Actual hearing establishes the sensory channel through which hidden stress is registered.
The elevated groan or drawn breath supplies an audible pressure signal.
Boiling and surging provide the internal pressure behind the signal.
Opening and fissure supply the structural defect that sight is challenged to locate.
Visual perception supplies the earlier inspection channel that finds no rupture.
Exhausted, cut-off strength marks the failure of repeated visual inspection.
Near severing or tearing names the boundary failure toward which the focus pressure tends.
Fury made manifest until heard explicitly links inner agitation to audible output.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from مَا تَرَىٰ ... مِن فُطُورٍ and repeated looking to hearing in 67:7 and near tearing in 67:8.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies absent visible fissure, exhausted sight, boiling, audible fury, and near tearing; I infer that the focus sound is a stress signal preceding rupture. It may instead be a roar with no diagnostic structural function.

changed_reading.before: The shahiq is simply one of the fire's terrifying noises.
changed_reading.after: The shahiq becomes audible boundary stress, exposing by sound the pressure that culminates in the destination's near disintegration.

context_deltas.mechanism: The continuation repeats casting for each group, while the later context moves from beings spread or sown in the earth to their being driven together toward one destination. The focus event therefore scales from one arrival scene into a recurring aggregation-and-intake cycle.

activation_trace.role: Casting supplies the delivery operation at the focus threshold.
A first surge makes each delivery capable of initiating a fresh response.
Repeated casting restates the same delivery operation for the next unit.
A group of people supplies the batch unit delivered by each repetition.
Sowing across earth activates an exploratory image of prior dispersal.
Driving and collecting a crowd toward a destination supplies the aggregation stage before delivery.

structural_cues: كُلَّمَا in 67:8 makes the casting recurrent, and its singular فَوْج makes the incoming plural a sequence of groups.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated group casting, earth-distribution imagery, and collection toward a destination; I infer a dispersal-to-aggregation-to-intake pipeline. ذ ر ء may carry creation without spatial sowing, but فَوْج plus ح ش ر still sustain the batch model.

changed_reading.after: 67:7 is one cycle in a repeated process: dispersed people are gathered, delivered group by group, and met by a fresh surge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The confession contrasts responsive hearing and reason that did not occur with the unavoidable acoustic hearing that now does. The later naming of hearing and inward faculties as created endowments, followed by little gratitude, turns the focus hearing into a reversal of use: the faculty that failed to receive warning must receive consequence.

activation_trace.role: Bare acoustic perception supplies the hearing that cannot now be avoided.
Understanding, accepting, and complying supply the responsive hearing admitted to have been absent.
Reason that restrains ignorance defines the unrealized partner of responsive hearing.
Bringing the faculties into existence frames hearing as a supplied capacity rather than an accidental sense.
The endowed faculty of hearing is the same sensory channel compelled in the focus.
The heart imagined as inward kindling gives responsive hearing an internal faculty that the focus's external sound now bypasses.
Recognition of a benefaction supplies the expected response whose scarcity completes the reversal.

structural_cues: The counterfactual لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ follows the actual سَمِعُوا, and 67:23 repeats the hearing root among endowed faculties.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies actual hearing, counterfactual responsive hearing with reason, and hearing as an under-thanked endowment; I infer a temporal and functional reversal from refused reception to compelled perception. The focus can still denote acoustic consequence without asserting that every use of س م ع has the same sense.

changed_reading.before: Hearing merely reports what reaches the entrants' ears.
changed_reading.after: Their unavoidable hearing is the late, inverted use of a faculty that earlier failed to understand and respond: warning was not received, but consequence must be.

context_deltas.mechanism: The syntactic echo between وَهِىَ تَفُورُ and فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ places boiling fire beside potentially heaving earth. The later bird image adds alternating contraction and extension held aloft, so surging and stability appear as selectable created states rather than a division between chaos and order.

activation_trace.role: Boiling and surging supply the focus state of violent motion.
Oscillation and wave motion give the earth a grammatically echoed state of possible instability.
Contraction after extension supplies controlled alternating motion rather than collapse.
Holding and restraining supply the sustaining force that can bound motion.

structural_cues: The clauses وَهِىَ تَفُورُ and فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ repeat the feminine independent pronoun plus an imperfect motion verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies echoed surge vocabulary and a held contraction-extension pattern; I infer that the focus turbulence is permitted and bounded rather than autonomous failure. The earth and bird scenes may instead be separate warnings and signs with no shared mechanics.

changed_reading.before: The boiling marks a region outside stable created order.
changed_reading.after: The boiling is one deliberately active state within a world where bodies may be made to heave, contract, extend, or remain held.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later contrast between face-down movement and upright movement on a straight path gives the passive casting a trajectory. Those who enter in 67:7 no longer walk under their own orientation; their terminal movement is externally imposed, the kinematic opposite of guided, balanced advance.

activation_trace.role: Being cast supplies externally imposed motion and loss of locomotor agency.
Turning or dropping onto the face supplies the anti-upright orientation.
Gentle direction toward the path supplies the guidance absent from terminal casting.
Bodily straightness and completeness provide the positive orientation lost at the endpoint.
A straight road supplies self-directed forward passage as the contrasting route.
Uprightness, balance, and rectitude complete the contrast with being thrown.

structural_cues: 67:22 balances two ways of moving, face-down and upright, while 67:7 uses a passive verb of forced transfer rather than walking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forced casting and the later face-down/upright route contrast; I infer that 67:7 is the endpoint of failed orientation. The focus does not state bodily posture, so the claim is about agency and trajectory, not a literal face-down landing.

changed_reading.before: Casting only describes how the entrants cross into the fire.
changed_reading.after: Casting is terminal anti-guidance: self-directed upright movement has ended, and their trajectory is imposed by another.

context_deltas.mechanism: The questioned appointment becomes fulfilled action and then rushes into nearness. Read back into the focus, إِذَا is the threshold where a disputed future stops being speech about an event and becomes bodily contact, marked by the destination's first surge.

activation_trace.role: Encounter between opposing sides supplies the instant when anticipated threat becomes contact.
The first impulse before settling marks fulfillment's immediate onset.
An appointment bounded by time or place supplies the future event being demanded.
Making a promise true in action supplies the conversion from claim to event.
A rush into proximity collapses the distance between the questioned promise and its witnesses.

structural_cues: مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ asks for the event's time, فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً marks arrival, and إِذَا in the focus opens the contact scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an appointed threat, its truth in action, nearness, and focus contact; I infer a threshold sequence from remote speech to embodied fulfillment. زُلْفَة may denote perceived nearness without literal rushing, but the collapse of temporal distance remains live.

changed_reading.before: إِذَا merely dates a punishment scene.
changed_reading.after: إِذَا opens the fulfillment threshold: the debated future becomes immediate contact, and the receiver answers that contact with its first surge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain material analogy, not a claim that the destination is water. It remains anchored in ف و ر's literal boiling and in the ending's water-depth-source sequence; downstream prose should present it as an exploratory inversion of fluid accessibility and direction.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تَفُورُ permits literal fluidlike boiling and upward surge around matter cast into a containing field.

activation_trace.role: Casting supplies matter driven down into the active field.
Boiling and upward ejection supply the rising side of the material inversion.
Water's appearance, entry, and abundance provide the life-sustaining fluid baseline.
Descent into inaccessible depth supplies the opposite direction to the focus's upward surge.
A flowing spring supplies the desired accessible emergence that contrasts with destructive boiling.

changed_reading.before: Boiling is only a conventional intensifier of fire.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory material inversion, the cast descend into a fluidlike field that surges upward, while the closing life-water can descend beyond reach and must be sought as a benign emerging source.

strongest_changes: The sound becomes audible boundary stress between the heavens' unfindable fissure and the destination's near tearing.
Actual hearing in 67:7 reverses the responsive hearing and reasoning later confessed absent, then reappears as an under-thanked created endowment.
The scene scales into recurrent batch intake: each gathered group is cast in and met by a fresh surge.
The disputed promise crosses a fulfillment threshold from remote speech to immediate bodily contact.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah is unusually dense in coupled mechanics: passive delivery, compulsory sensing, breathlike sound, and boiling motion. Context repeatedly changes those mechanics through structural rupture, sensory reversal, aggregation, controlled stability, bodily orientation, and temporal arrival without forcing them into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether شَهِيق is best assigned to the destination as inhalation, groan, roar, or a pressure signal remains open.
The batch pipeline is strong from كُلَّمَا, فَوْج, and ح ش ر, while the sowing/dispersal contribution of ذ ر ء is exploratory.
The controlled-instability model depends on treating the echoed هِىَ plus motion clauses as mechanically significant rather than merely stylistic.
The hydraulic inversion should remain an analogy and not be lexicalized into the focus beyond ف و ر's boiling image.
